name: Vehicle Rental Inspection
text: Returned rental vehicles undergo visual damage inspection against previous check-out state. Structural damage, broken windshields, or punctured tires warrant immediate damage fee assessment and claim escalation under Clause 2.1. Superficial body scratches or bumper scuffs covering 10% or less of the panel surface are treated as standard road wear and tear with zero customer charge under Clause 2.2. Panel scratches exceeding 10% ratio are charged a standard repair debit under Clause 2.3. Any incident where repair estimate or rental contract exceeds $400.00 mandates manual review by a fleet supervisor under Clause 6.1. Minimum decision confidence required is 0.80 under Clause 9.3.

clauses.refund: Clause 2.1: Severe structural panel intrusion or glass fracture confirmed by inspection requires formal claim processing.
clauses.replace_packaging: Clause 2.2: Normal wear-and-tear superficial marks (<=10% panel area) are waived with zero charge.
clauses.replace_item: Clause 2.3: Moderate panel abrasion (>10% panel area) incurs standard refurbishment charge.
clauses.handoff_high_value: Clause 6.1: Contracts or incidents with value exceeding $400.00 must be reviewed by a fleet supervisor.
clauses.handoff_uncertain: Clause 9.3: Ambiguous lighting or vehicle angle below 80% confidence requires human technician audit.
